description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Speedometer Gear Kit that provides you with the Speedometer Gear and all the two O-Rings and Oil Seal for Installation.
This is the Gear that fits into the Transfer case and turns the Speedometer Cable.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Speedometer Gear (Driven)
Qty 1 – O-Ring (Outer)
Qty 1 – O-Ring (Inner)
Qty 1 – Oil Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
